authority.purpose: Shared source-to-claim authority for future Big Five bilingual public content packages.

sources.title: An alternative "description of personality": The Big-Five factor structure.
sources.supported_claim: Lexical trait descriptors can be organized into a Big Five factor structure.
sources.limitation: The study supports a broad factor structure; it does not validate FermatMind scores, diagnose an individual, or establish a universal facet taxonomy.

sources.title: The next Big Five Inventory (BFI-2): Developing and assessing a hierarchical model with 15 facets to enhance bandwidth, fidelity, and predictive power.
sources.authors_or_organization: Christopher J. Soto and Oliver P. John
sources.supported_claim: The BFI-2 operationalizes five broad domains and 15 facets in a hierarchical measurement model.
sources.limitation: BFI-2's 15 facets must not be presented as identical to a 10-aspect or 30-facet taxonomy, and this source does not validate FermatMind's assessment implementation.

sources.title: Between facets and domains: 10 aspects of the Big Five.
sources.authors_or_organization: Colin G. DeYoung, Lena C. Quilty, and Jordan B. Peterson
sources.supported_claim: An alternative hierarchy identifies two intermediate aspects within each Big Five domain.
sources.limitation: The ten aspects are not interchangeable with BFI-2 facets or NEO/IPIP-style 30-facet navigation labels.

sources.title: Ten facet scales for the Big Five Inventory: Convergence with NEO PI-R facets, self-peer agreement, and discriminant validity.
sources.authors_or_organization: Christopher J. Soto and Oliver P. John
sources.supported_claim: Facet-level measurement can add specificity beneath broad Big Five domains.
sources.limitation: Evidence about these ten BFI facet scales does not establish equivalence with other facet systems or authorize score conversion.

sources.title: Patterns of mean-level change in personality traits across the life course: A meta-analysis of longitudinal studies.
sources.authors_or_organization: Brent W. Roberts, Kate E. Walton, and Wolfgang Viechtbauer
sources.supported_claim: Longitudinal evidence shows patterns of mean-level personality-trait change across the life course.
sources.limitation: Group-level mean change does not predict how, why, or whether a particular individual will change, and does not support a guaranteed intervention outcome.

sources.title: NEO Facets Table
sources.authors_or_organization: International Personality Item Pool, Oregon Research Institute
sources.supported_claim: The official IPIP resource documents corresponding public-domain scales for 30 NEO-style facet constructs.
sources.limitation: Correspondence does not establish identity with proprietary NEO instruments, BFI-2 facets, ten-aspect models, or FermatMind scores.

sources.title: FermatMind Personality Public Content Asset V2 contract
sources.supported_claim: The backend V2 contract defines explicit visible source, claim mapping, limitation, editorial actor/date, media authority, and eligibility fields that fail closed by default.
sources.limitation: A data contract is product authority, not independent scientific validation and not evidence that any page is reviewed, published, indexable, or schema-eligible.

sources.title: Big Five public landscape benchmark snapshot
sources.authors_or_organization: FermatMind read-only benchmark of publicly visible Truity surfaces
sources.supported_claim: The captured public landscape includes test, hub, domain, facet, report, and technical-document surface patterns.
sources.limitation: This snapshot is time-bound structural evidence only. Competitor copy, claims, ratings, prices, and technical documents are not FermatMind scientific or product authority and must not be copied.

sources.title: FermatMind public claim boundary matrix
sources.supported_claim: Public assessment content must remain non-diagnostic, non-deterministic, and outside hiring, admission, medical, financial, and legal decision use.
sources.limitation: Repository policy governs FermatMind claims but does not constitute peer-reviewed evidence about the Big Five model.

sources.title: Taxonomy separation editorial inference
sources.authors_or_organization: FermatMind editorial synthesis; human review required
sources.supported_claim: When a page uses a specific facet taxonomy, it must name that taxonomy and avoid presenting alternative facet or aspect systems as equivalent.
sources.limitation: This is a conservative editorial inference from multiple sources, not a standalone scientific source; a human reviewer must approve page-level wording.

claims.allowed_summary_en: The Big Five organizes personality-trait descriptions into five broad dimensions.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 大五人格将人格特质描述组织为五个宽泛维度。
claims.limitation: Five broad dimensions do not define a whole person, establish a diagnosis, or determine an outcome.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Broad Big Five domains can be described at more specific facet or aspect levels, depending on the named measurement model.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 在明确测量模型的前提下，大五人格的宽泛维度可以进一步用更具体的侧面或方面来描述。
claims.limitation: A page must identify its taxonomy; facet counts and labels from different models are not silently merged.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Longitudinal research finds group-level patterns of mean trait change across the life course.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 纵向研究发现，人格特质均值在生命历程中存在群体层面的变化模式。
claims.limitation: This does not predict individual change or guarantee that a specific exercise, event, or intervention will change a person's score.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Named facet and aspect systems should be kept distinct rather than presented as interchangeable.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 已命名的侧面体系与方面体系应保持区分，不应被表述为可互换。
claims.limitation: This is an editorial synthesis. Page-level language remains blocked until the chosen taxonomy and reviewer are explicit.

claims.allowed_summary_en: FermatMind Big Five content is a structured reference for reflection, not a diagnosis or deterministic decision tool.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 费马测试的大五人格内容是用于反思的结构化参考，不是诊断或决定性决策工具。
claims.limitation: This is a FermatMind product boundary, not a scientific validity or regulatory claim.

claims.allowed_summary_en: The V2 backend contract can carry visible sources, claim mappings, limitations, editorial actors and dates, and media authority with explicit eligibility gates.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: V2 后端契约可承载可见来源、论断映射、局限、编辑责任人与日期、媒体权威字段，并使用显式资格 gate。
claims.limitation: Field availability does not prove that a page is reviewed, published, indexable, schema-eligible, or cited by a search/AI system.

claims.allowed_summary_en: The read-only competitor snapshot records public page-family and visible evidence patterns for structural comparison.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 只读竞品快照记录公开页面族与可见证据模式，仅供结构比较。
claims.limitation: Competitor observations cannot support FermatMind scientific, superiority, accuracy, pricing, rating, or endorsement claims.

forbidden_claims: hiring, admission, legal, financial, salary, or relationship outcome prediction
specific reliability, validity, norm, or percentile numbers without approved public evidence
facet-system equivalence or score conversion without direct validation
competitor copy or secondary media used as sole scientific evidence
schema, sitemap, llms, search ranking, AI citation, or indexability guarantees
